content: The American College of Pediatricians (ACPeds) is a medical organization in the United States composed of conservative pediatricians and other healthcare professionals. It was established in 2002 by Dr. Joseph Zanga as a response to the American Academy of Pediatrics' endorsement of LGBT parental rights. The positions held by the American College of Pediatricians are socially conservative in nature. These include advocating for the prohibition of parenting by homosexual individuals, promoting restrictions on children's access to television and other media, opposing legislation that mandates HPV vaccinations, opposing the legalization of marijuana, and opposing abortion. PFLAG, an organization that supports LGBTQ+ individuals and their families, identifies the American College of Pediatricians as an anti-equality organization. PFLAG describes ACPeds as a small splinter group of medical professionals who reject the mainstream perspective of the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), which recognizes homosexuality as a normal aspect of human diversity.
